Kentucky  
5-10, 224  
Westerville, Ohio  
Westerville Central High School

**CAREER NOTES**  
Started 27 of 39 games at Kentuckyâ¦broke or tied 14 school records, including career rushing yards (3,873), total touchdowns (48), rushing touchdowns (48) and 100-yard games (19)â¦ranks second on program rushing attempts (737) and third on all-time scoring (290) chartsâ¦scored his 40th touchdown in just 31 games, the second fastest in SEC history to do soâ¦became first Wildcat to amass 1,000-yards in a season three times.

Second-Team All-America and First-Team All-SEC selectionâ¦rushed for 1,449 yards â second-most in a single-season in school history â and for 16 touchdownsâ¦helped lead Kentucky to a 10-3 record, the team's best mark in 41 yearsâ¦finished second in the SEC and ninth in the nation in rushing touchdowns (16)â¦rushed for 175 yards on 27 attempts at Florida (Sept. 8)â¦tied a school record with four rushing touchdowns in win over No. 14 Mississippi State (Sept. 22), gaining 165 yards on 25 carriesâ¦amassed 169 yards a win vs. Vanderbilt (Oct. 20), gaining 74 yards on an 80-yard game-winning drive, capped off by his own seven-yard touchdownâ¦named MVP of VRBO Citrus Bowl vs. Penn State (Jan. 1), after rushing 26 times for 144 yards and two touchdowns in a 27-24 win.
